quests.crisisScene: A house fire call comes in: parents say their baby is still inside upstairs, while they stand safely outside. Input code!
quests.question: Select the correct emergency dispatch action for this situation:
options: GET THE BABY'S EXACT LOCATION IMMEDIATELY
Send an informal email to customer service and go about your daily routine.
Throw cold water directly onto an active electrical or grease fire.
quests.correctAnswer: GET THE BABY'S EXACT LOCATION IMMEDIATELY
quests.explanation: An exact location lets firefighters go straight to the baby instead of searching the whole house room by room.

quests.crisisScene: The parents say the baby's room is at the back of the house, the side the fire hasn't reached yet. Input code!
quests.question: Select the correct emergency dispatch action for this situation:
options: Tell the affected individuals to calm down and walk away without rendering aid.
PASS THIS ON, IT MAY CHANGE THE ENTRY POINT
Confront armed suspects alone while shouting threats.
quests.correctAnswer: PASS THIS ON, IT MAY CHANGE THE ENTRY POINT
quests.explanation: Knowing the fire hasn't reached that side yet may let firefighters enter through a safer route to reach the baby faster.

quests.crisisScene: A neighbor reports smoke from the same house but confirms no one else was home at the time. Input code!
quests.question: Select the correct emergency dispatch action for this situation:
options: Wait until tomorrow morning to see if the situation resolves itself naturally.
Rush blindly into the active danger zone without any safety gear or training.
CONFIRM NO ONE ELSE IS INSIDE
quests.correctAnswer: CONFIRM NO ONE ELSE IS INSIDE
quests.explanation: Confirming no one else is inside lets firefighters focus entirely on reaching the baby without searching for anyone else.

quests.crisisScene: At a construction site, one worker has a broken arm and another has been exposed to fumes and is coughing hard. Input code!
quests.question: Select the correct emergency dispatch action for this situation:
options: TREAT THE FUME EXPOSURE AS HIGHER PRIORITY
Post on a neighborhood social forum to ask bystanders what they think you should do.
Attempt invasive emergency surgery on the spot using unsterilized kitchen utensils.
quests.correctAnswer: TREAT THE FUME EXPOSURE AS HIGHER PRIORITY
quests.explanation: Fume exposure risks the airway and lungs, which is more urgent than a broken arm, even though the fracture looks more dramatic.

quests.crisisScene: The coughing worker suddenly can't catch his breath at all. Input code!
quests.question: Select the correct emergency dispatch action for this situation:
options: Ignore the situation completely since it is taking place outside your own property.
ESCALATE HIS CASE TO THE HIGHEST URGENCY
Scream loudly in the street while running in circles to incite mass panic.
quests.correctAnswer: ESCALATE HIS CASE TO THE HIGHEST URGENCY
quests.explanation: Being completely unable to breathe is immediately life-threatening, so this now becomes the single highest priority on the scene.

quests.crisisScene: A third worker at the same site has only mild dust irritation in his eyes. Input code!
quests.question: Select the correct emergency dispatch action for this situation:
options: Take a smartphone video from across the street and wait for someone else to call.
Pull the entire municipal electrical transformer lever without authorization.
TREAT THIS AS THE LOWEST PRIORITY HERE
quests.correctAnswer: TREAT THIS AS THE LOWEST PRIORITY HERE
quests.explanation: Mild eye irritation is far less urgent than a breathing emergency or fracture, so it can wait until the others are handled.

quests.crisisScene: A woman reports a mild, familiar headache along with unrelated back pain from gardening. Input code!
quests.question: Select the correct emergency dispatch action for this situation:
options: NEITHER NEEDS EMERGENCY SERVICES RIGHT NOW
Search online medical blogs for an hour before taking any physical action.
Offer an unconscious person a glass of water and force them to swallow.
quests.correctAnswer: NEITHER NEEDS EMERGENCY SERVICES RIGHT NOW
quests.explanation: A familiar mild headache and ordinary back pain are both non-urgent, so neither needs to be prioritized for emergency care.

quests.crisisScene: The same woman's headache suddenly becomes the worst she's ever felt, unlike the back pain which hasn't changed. Input code!
quests.question: Select the correct emergency dispatch action for this situation:
options: Assume emergency services are already on their way without verifying.
PRIORITIZE THE HEADACHE, IT HAS CHANGED CHARACTER
Move a victim with a potential spinal injury abruptly to sit them upright.
quests.correctAnswer: PRIORITIZE THE HEADACHE, IT HAS CHANGED CHARACTER
quests.explanation: A sudden, severe change in a familiar headache is a warning sign, unlike the back pain which has stayed exactly the same.

quests.crisisScene: A different caller has both mild back pain and a mild, familiar headache, with neither changing at all. Input code!
quests.question: Select the correct emergency dispatch action for this situation:
options: Send an informal email to customer service and go about your daily routine.
Throw cold water directly onto an active electrical or grease fire.
RECOMMEND HER USUAL REMEDIES AND A DOCTOR'S VISIT IF EITHER LASTS
quests.correctAnswer: RECOMMEND HER USUAL REMEDIES AND A DOCTOR'S VISIT IF EITHER LASTS
quests.explanation: Both symptoms are mild and familiar, so routine remedies and a doctor's visit if either lasts are enough.

quests.crisisScene: A caller reports a multi-car pileup on a foggy highway but hasn't gotten out to check anyone yet. Input code!
quests.question: Select the correct emergency dispatch action for this situation:
options: GET THE LOCATION FIRST, THEN ASK ABOUT INJURIES
Tell the affected individuals to calm down and walk away without rendering aid.
Confront armed suspects alone while shouting threats.
quests.correctAnswer: GET THE LOCATION FIRST, THEN ASK ABOUT INJURIES
quests.explanation: Confirming the exact location first ensures responders are already moving, even while injury details are still being gathered.

quests.crisisScene: The caller then reports seeing at least one person moving between two of the wrecked cars. Input code!
quests.question: Select the correct emergency dispatch action for this situation:
options: Wait until tomorrow morning to see if the situation resolves itself naturally.
WARN THAT PERSON TO STAY OFF THE ROAD
Rush blindly into the active danger zone without any safety gear or training.
quests.correctAnswer: WARN THAT PERSON TO STAY OFF THE ROAD
quests.explanation: Someone walking between wrecked cars on a foggy highway risks being hit by another vehicle, so they need an immediate warning.

quests.crisisScene: A different caller reports a single stalled car on the highway shoulder, driver safely inside with hazards on. Input code!
quests.question: Select the correct emergency dispatch action for this situation:
options: Post on a neighborhood social forum to ask bystanders what they think you should do.
Attempt invasive emergency surgery on the spot using unsterilized kitchen utensils.
REPORT IT AS A LOW-PRIORITY BREAKDOWN
quests.correctAnswer: REPORT IT AS A LOW-PRIORITY BREAKDOWN
quests.explanation: A safely stopped car with hazards on is a routine breakdown, not comparable in urgency to an active multi-car pileup.

quests.crisisScene: A caller reports a slow leak dripping from their ceiling that's gotten a little worse over the past week. Input code!
quests.question: Select the correct emergency dispatch action for this situation:
options: ARRANGE A REPAIR AND PLACE A BUCKET UNDER THE LEAK
Ignore the situation completely since it is taking place outside your own property.
Scream loudly in the street while running in circles to incite mass panic.
quests.correctAnswer: ARRANGE A REPAIR AND PLACE A BUCKET UNDER THE LEAK
quests.explanation: A slow, gradually worsening leak is a maintenance issue, not an emergency, since it hasn't created sudden danger.

quests.crisisScene: The same ceiling suddenly collapses, and part of it falls near where a child was playing. Input code!
quests.question: Select the correct emergency dispatch action for this situation:
options: Take a smartphone video from across the street and wait for someone else to call.
GET HELP NOW AND KEEP THE CHILD CLEAR OF THE COLLAPSED AREA
Pull the entire municipal electrical transformer lever without authorization.
quests.correctAnswer: GET HELP NOW AND KEEP THE CHILD CLEAR OF THE COLLAPSED AREA
quests.explanation: A sudden structural collapse near a child is now an emergency, even though the leak itself had built up slowly.

quests.crisisScene: A different caller reports a ceiling stain that has looked exactly the same for months. Input code!
quests.question: Select the correct emergency dispatch action for this situation:
options: Search online medical blogs for an hour before taking any physical action.
Offer an unconscious person a glass of water and force them to swallow.
HAVE A ROOFER OR PLUMBER LOOK AT IT WHEN CONVENIENT
quests.correctAnswer: HAVE A ROOFER OR PLUMBER LOOK AT IT WHEN CONVENIENT
quests.explanation: An unchanging stain with no progression isn't an emergency and can be handled through routine home repair.

quests.crisisScene: A man insists he's 'totally fine' after a fall, but he can't remember what day it is. Input code!
quests.question: Select the correct emergency dispatch action for this situation:
options: TRUST THE SYMPTOM, NOT HIS OWN ASSESSMENT
Assume emergency services are already on their way without verifying.
Move a victim with a potential spinal injury abruptly to sit them upright.
quests.correctAnswer: TRUST THE SYMPTOM, NOT HIS OWN ASSESSMENT
quests.explanation: Confusion about the day is a concrete warning sign that outweighs his own claim of feeling fine after a fall.

quests.crisisScene: The same man then correctly answers several more questions and seems to be thinking clearly again. Input code!
quests.question: Select the correct emergency dispatch action for this situation:
options: Send an informal email to customer service and go about your daily routine.
REASSESS, BUT STILL RECOMMEND A CHECKUP
Throw cold water directly onto an active electrical or grease fire.
quests.correctAnswer: REASSESS, BUT STILL RECOMMEND A CHECKUP
quests.explanation: Recovering some clarity is reassuring, but a head injury still deserves a checkup, since confusion can return.

quests.crisisScene: A different caller after a minor bump confidently and consistently answers every question correctly. Input code!
quests.question: Select the correct emergency dispatch action for this situation:
options: Tell the affected individuals to calm down and walk away without rendering aid.
Confront armed suspects alone while shouting threats.
NO EMERGENCY, SUGGEST HE WATCH FOR HEADACHE OR DROWSINESS FOR A DAY
quests.correctAnswer: NO EMERGENCY, SUGGEST HE WATCH FOR HEADACHE OR DROWSINESS FOR A DAY
quests.explanation: When someone's own claim of feeling fine matches consistent, clear answers, there's no conflicting evidence to override it.

quests.crisisScene: A kitchen fire has injured the cook with burns, and grease has spread flaming onto the floor. Input code!
quests.question: Select the correct emergency dispatch action for this situation:
options: REQUEST FIRE AND MEDICAL RESPONSE TOGETHER
Wait until tomorrow morning to see if the situation resolves itself naturally.
Rush blindly into the active danger zone without any safety gear or training.
quests.correctAnswer: REQUEST FIRE AND MEDICAL RESPONSE TOGETHER
quests.explanation: Both the spreading fire and the burn injury need immediate, simultaneous responses, since neither can safely wait.

quests.crisisScene: The cook is now trying to put the fire out himself despite his burns. Input fire code!
quests.question: Select the correct emergency dispatch action for this situation:
options: Post on a neighborhood social forum to ask bystanders what they think you should do.
TELL HIM TO GET OUT, NOT FIGHT THE FIRE
Attempt invasive emergency surgery on the spot using unsterilized kitchen utensils.
quests.correctAnswer: TELL HIM TO GET OUT, NOT FIGHT THE FIRE
quests.explanation: An injured person fighting a spreading fire risks worse harm, so getting him to safety matters more than saving the kitchen.

quests.crisisScene: A small kitchen fire has been put out with a pot lid, but the oil pan is still smoking. Input code!
quests.question: Select the correct emergency dispatch action for this situation:
options: Ignore the situation completely since it is taking place outside your own property.
Scream loudly in the street while running in circles to incite mass panic.
LEAVE THE LID ON, TURN OFF THE HEAT, AND LET THE PAN COOL
quests.correctAnswer: LEAVE THE LID ON, TURN OFF THE HEAT, AND LET THE PAN COOL
quests.explanation: Oil can reignite if the lid is lifted early. Keeping the lid on and the heat off lets it cool safely.

quests.crisisScene: Two people fall on an icy sidewalk moments apart: a healthy young adult and an elderly man. Input code!
quests.question: Select the correct emergency dispatch action for this situation:
options: CHECK THE ELDERLY MAN FIRST, THEN THE OTHER
Take a smartphone video from across the street and wait for someone else to call.
Pull the entire municipal electrical transformer lever without authorization.
quests.correctAnswer: CHECK THE ELDERLY MAN FIRST, THEN THE OTHER
quests.explanation: An elderly person is generally more vulnerable to serious injury from the same kind of fall, so checking him first makes sense.

quests.crisisScene: The young adult then says his wrist is bent at an unnatural angle. Input code!
quests.question: Select the correct emergency dispatch action for this situation:
options: Search online medical blogs for an hour before taking any physical action.
TREAT BOTH AS EQUAL PRIORITY NOW
Offer an unconscious person a glass of water and force them to swallow.
quests.correctAnswer: TREAT BOTH AS EQUAL PRIORITY NOW
quests.explanation: A visibly deformed wrist is a clear, serious injury that now makes both cases equally urgent, regardless of age.

quests.crisisScene: In a separate incident, two healthy adults of similar age both have minor bruises from a slip. Input code!
quests.question: Select the correct emergency dispatch action for this situation:
options: Assume emergency services are already on their way without verifying.
Move a victim with a potential spinal injury abruptly to sit them upright.
CHECK THEM IN THE ORDER THEY ARRIVED, NEITHER NEEDS PRIORITY
quests.correctAnswer: CHECK THEM IN THE ORDER THEY ARRIVED, NEITHER NEEDS PRIORITY
quests.explanation: With similar ages and similarly minor injuries, nothing justifies putting one person ahead of the other.

quests.crisisScene: While reporting a car crash, the caller remembers the driver mentioned chest pain just before the crash happened. Input code!
quests.question: Select the correct emergency dispatch action for this situation:
options: VOLUNTEER THIS DETAIL, EVEN IF NOT ASKED
Send an informal email to customer service and go about your daily routine.
Throw cold water directly onto an active electrical or grease fire.
quests.correctAnswer: VOLUNTEER THIS DETAIL, EVEN IF NOT ASKED
quests.explanation: Chest pain before the crash could mean a medical event caused it, which matters for how paramedics treat him.

quests.crisisScene: The caller also remembers the driver's radio was playing loudly, which seems unrelated. Input code!
quests.question: Select the correct emergency dispatch action for this situation:
options: Tell the affected individuals to calm down and walk away without rendering aid.
LEAVE IT OUT OF THE REPORT
Confront armed suspects alone while shouting threats.
quests.correctAnswer: LEAVE IT OUT OF THE REPORT
quests.explanation: A loud radio has no bearing on his medical condition or the crash response, so it doesn't need to be passed on.

quests.crisisScene: A different caller remembers the crash happened right after the driver swerved to avoid a dog in the road. Input code!
quests.question: Select the correct emergency dispatch action for this situation:
options: Wait until tomorrow morning to see if the situation resolves itself naturally.
Rush blindly into the active danger zone without any safety gear or training.
MENTION THE SWERVE, IT EXPLAINS THE CRASH
quests.correctAnswer: MENTION THE SWERVE, IT EXPLAINS THE CRASH
quests.explanation: Mentioning the swerve gives responders a clearer picture of the crash, which can be useful, unlike the irrelevant radio detail.

quests.crisisScene: A caller reports a collapsed scaffold at a construction site, with one worker pinned and another shouting that gas cylinders nearby have started hissing. Input code!
quests.question: Select the correct emergency dispatch action for this situation:
options: REPORT THE GAS HAZARD AND THE PINNED WORKER TOGETHER
Post on a neighborhood social forum to ask bystanders what they think you should do.
Attempt invasive emergency surgery on the spot using unsterilized kitchen utensils.
quests.correctAnswer: REPORT THE GAS HAZARD AND THE PINNED WORKER TOGETHER
quests.explanation: Both the pinned worker and the hissing gas need immediate attention, since one threatens him directly and the other threatens everyone nearby.

quests.crisisScene: Responders ask which of the two problems needs the first team on scene. Input code!
quests.question: Select the correct emergency dispatch action for this situation:
options: Ignore the situation completely since it is taking place outside your own property.
SEND THE HAZARD TEAM FIRST TO SECURE THE SCENE
Scream loudly in the street while running in circles to incite mass panic.
quests.correctAnswer: SEND THE HAZARD TEAM FIRST TO SECURE THE SCENE
quests.explanation: Securing the gas hazard first makes it safe for rescuers to then reach and free the pinned worker without added risk.

quests.crisisScene: A second, unrelated call reports a minor two-car fender bender with no injuries, in a different part of town. Input code!
quests.question: Select the correct emergency dispatch action for this situation:
options: Take a smartphone video from across the street and wait for someone else to call.
Pull the entire municipal electrical transformer lever without authorization.
TREAT THIS AS FAR LOWER PRIORITY
quests.correctAnswer: TREAT THIS AS FAR LOWER PRIORITY
quests.explanation: A minor fender-bender with no injuries is far less urgent than an active multi-hazard rescue and can wait for available responders.
